entries.97a5566758642dfb: Its management philosophy is 'Aiming to be a company that contributes to society through warmth-making, with quality and taste as keywords,' and its management policy states: 'Providing sustainable + (plus) value to all stakeholders through the creation of better accent fashion.' Under its medium-term management plan for the fiscal years ended March 2025 to March 2027, its business growth strategy calls for 4 measures: strengthening product development and marketing for the specialty store market, deploying new store strategies to expand directly operated stores and retail business, further expanding E-commerce business, and opening new sales channels in Japan and overseas. Its business optimization strategy promotes optimization and streamlining of existing businesses, aiming to review and rebuild its business portfolio.
